messages.author: slotherer
messages.text:
Random List of QoL suggestions:

1. What your population still needs (1 to fix) - can be moved close to the top. Include new line items: Unpowered, Unstable, Negative on Resources (from trading/factories)

2. A more comprehensive pre(?)-calculator? There's already an auto cost calculator for city/land, and in the mass purchase section, but not in individual provinces when buying buildings. Please remember to include to red out and let us know how much more of something is needed to complete our purchase.  Including calculation on sufficient manpower/workers would be great too - since that can really kill your entire economy

3. Across the board - don't kick us back to another page/tab. Happens to me all the time on #2 because I'm just trying to get the game to help me calculate but it only appears after, and meanwhile, kicks me back to province overview so I have to change tabs and type in my number again.

4. In Province view, please keep relevant info up top, like Power, City, Lands, so I don't have to keep going back to overview to check and then going back to Buildings / Mil / Res to build.


Not quite QoL - but Economic Balance seems all focused on Steel & Components for whatever reason. They are the only factories that need workers and Projects are mostly towards Steel.

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@249007223454433292> all four are live. 1) "What your population still needs" is at the top of your nation page now, with new lines for unpowered provinces, unstable provinces and resources you lose every hour. 2) on a province's Buildings tab, type an amount and it shows the full cost live (gold, each resource, slots, workers) and goes red with how much more you need. city/land cost updates as you type too. 3) buying/selling/building no longer kicks you back to the overview, you stay on your tab. 4) Power, City, Land and Gold stay pinned at the top while you're in the province tabs. the steel/components balance thing I left alone, that one goes to the vote.

messages.author: slotherer
messages.text:
5. checkbox or something to auto-buy cities or land as needed when buying buildings?
eg. checkbox autobuy land next to steel mills so when I buy 100 steel mills, it buys up to 100 land as needed for my province

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@249007223454433292> got your #5, auto-buying land or cities when you buy buildings. it's next on my list. I'll post here when it's live.

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@249007223454433292> #5 is live. on a province's building tabs there's a checkbox, 'Also buy the land/city slots I need'. tick it and when you type more buildings than you have free slots, the cost preview includes the extra slots, and Buy gets just the missing ones first and then builds. if you're short on gold or materials it buys nothing. it's off by default.

messages.author: slotherer
messages.text:
For the Things to be Fixed - I would suggest a Bar almost on the top for every page, but only with red things like power, and rations, and lack of resources. (not hospitals? Not many can afford that yet).
The UI is still messy and I have to be at multiple pages and sometimes I forget to check back to the Overview page to see the problems that occurred while playing.

And like moving unpowered/unstable provinces to the top of the list, the Things to be Fixed should also move red items to the top of its list (with hospitals last in the reds)

Also, to add calculator and staying on the same tab to Military pages also.

And to the War screens, to reduce number of clicks needed and for the repeat attack buttons to work.

messages.author: slotherer
messages.text: Add Drones & Missiles to War page

messages.author: slotherer
messages.text:
On Military Screen, under span clas="game-hero-badge" there is a manpower number.

In the paragraph of text description about Military there is another manpower number.

They are not equal

if formula is 10% of working-class pop, then the higher one seems wrong.

messages.author: slotherer
messages.text:
There is already a very brief summary of buildings destroyed - please add a summary for the involved nations detailing the damage to their nations. How many buildings destroyed and where.
Preferably with links to the provinces. Even better with a "repair all button" with checkboxes so we insta-repair.

messages.text: Please add checkbox for auto-buy city/land to mass purchase screen also
